items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the state law, in relation to designating the state of New
York a purple heart state
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S4459

SPONSOR: ASHBY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the state law, in relation to designating the state of
New York a purple heart state

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To amend the state law, in relation to designating the state of New York
a Purple Heart state.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. State law is amended by adding section 92. This designates
the state of New York as a Purple Heart State

Section 2 sets forth the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill will designate New York State as a Purple Heart state,
enshrining into law our gratitude for the sacrifices made by wounded
Veterans.

New York State is already the proud home of the National Purple Heart
Hall of Honor; designating New York State as a Purple Heart state would
solidify our commitment to wounded veterans of our state.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2022: A.7961/S.2279 - died in Assembly government ops; Passed Senate.

2021: A.7961/S.2279 - died in Assembly government ops; Passed Senate.

2020: A.10598/S.6745 - notice of committee consideration requested.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the first of January next succeeding the
date upon which it shall become law.
